articles.title: Indian Prime Minister Modi Urges Unity Against National Threats

articles.title: Governments Worldwide Shape What Artificial Intelligence Says About Politics
articles.summary: Governments across the world are increasingly regulating artificial intelligence chatbot responses regarding political leaders and elections. Researchers from Vanderbilt University report that nations utilize national security laws and content restrictions to control political discussions. Because global tech companies often apply uniform policies worldwide, international regulations directly impact the information that voters receive at home.

articles.title: Apple India's revenue more than doubles in 3 years, crosses ₹1 lakh crore
articles.summary: Apple India Pvt Ltd's revenue from operations crossed ₹1 lakh crore for the first time in FY26, rising 31% year on year to ₹1,03,853 crore. Revenue has more than doubled from ₹49,188 crore in FY23, according to filings with the Registrar of Companies (RoC) and reports. Net profit rose 66% to ₹5,311 crore in FY26 from ₹3,196 crore in FY25.

articles.summary_hinglish: Apple indiya praiveta limiteda ka sanchalana se rajasva FY26 men pahali bara ₹1 lakha karoda ko para kara gay, jo sala dara sala 31% badhakara ₹1,03,853 karoda ho gaya। rajistrara ऑpha kanpanija (aaraosi) ki phailinga aura riporta ke anusar, rajasva vitta varsha 2013 men ₹49,188 karoda se doguna se adhika ho gaya hai। vitta varsha 2026 men shuddha labha 66% badhakara ₹5,311 karoda ho gay, jo vitta varsha 25 men ₹3,196 karoda tha।

articles.summary_hi: संगठित मादक पदार्थों की तस्करी पर एक बड़ी कार्रवाई के लिए राजस्व खुफिया निदेशालय की ओर से जारी विज्ञप्ति का हवाला देते हुए, जिसमें नागपट्टिनम जिले के एक तटीय गांव से 137 किलोग्राम क्रिस्टल मेथमफेटामाइन, एक प्रतिबंधित सिंथेटिक दवा, की जब्ती हुई, उन्होंने कहा कि यह हाल के वर्षों में तमिलनाडु के तटीय क्षेत्र में सबसे बड़ी नशीले पदार्थों की बरामदगी में से एक थी।

articles.summary_hinglish: sangathita madaka padarthon ki taskari para eka badaी karravaee ke lie rajasva khuphiya nideshalaya ki ora se jari vijnyapti ka havala dete hue, jisamen nagapattinama jile ke eka tatiya ganva se 137 kilograma kristala methamaphetamain, eka pratibandhita sinthetika dav, ki jabti huee, unhonne kaha ki yaha hala ke varshon men tamilanadu ke tatiya kshetra men sabase badaी nashile padarthon ki baramadagi men se eka thi।
